about: Published API prices, for cost projections (and for real adapters when they're added). Micro-USD per million tokens. Cache prices are for the 5-minute cache. An openai-compat/<host>/<model> entry carries its own source and date, how its answer is asked for (answer: tools, json or text), context_tokens (its context window, checked before every call) and concurrency_cost (its share of the host's concurrent units) where the host gives them, and to_confirm while its price is unverified: a price to confirm is never used to run (docs/real-models.md, "Hosted open-weight models").
